# Visualizing the Ref Lifecycle

#### Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App

## Visualizing the Ref Lifecycle

Here's how the ref lifecycle looks like:

1. Create the Ref

Call useRef(null) to create the ref. At this point, current is null because nothing has rendered yet.

2. Attach to DOM

Add the ref attribute to a JSX element. React automatically sets ref.current to the DOM node once the element renders.

3. Use the Ref

Read ref.current to access the real DOM node and call browser methods on it like .focus() or .value.

![Visualizing the Ref Lifecycle](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Before we use this in the app (which we'll do in the next lesson), it's worth understanding how refs differ from state.
